    New Huanggang Port
    ....
    Transport Guide – 5 Shenzhen Metro Lines & 7 Proposed Bus Routes

    Hong Kong travelers will no longer need to rely purely on traditional cross-border buses. In the future, passengers can take the MTR or local buses directly from Hong Kong urban areas to the port, and step straight into the Shenzhen Metro after clearing customs.
    The new Huanggang Port is expected to connect 5 rail lines, including:

    • Shenzhen Metro Line 7
    • MTR Northern Link Spur Line
    • Shenzhen Metro Line 20
    • Shenzhen Metro Line 22
    • High-Speed Rail (HSR)

    Upon arrival, travelers can hop directly onto Shenzhen Metro Line 7 to access 10 major shopping centers, including Vi City, Teem Plaza, Rainbow Shopping Mall, MixC World Food, and Baoneng Global Hub.

    ...


    7 Newly Proposed Bus Routes

    To meet cross-border passenger demand following the opening of the new port, the Transport Department has proposed extending 3 existing franchised bus routes and introducing 4 brand-new franchised bus routes serving Kwai Chung, Kai Tak, Ma On Shan, and Tuen Mun.
    3 Proposed Route Extensions to Huanggang Port:


    • Citybus Route 976A: (San Tin Public Transport Interchange – Siu Sai Wan)
    • KMB Route N73: (San Tin Public Transport Interchange – Sha Tin Central)
    • KMB Route 276B: (Tin Fu – Sheung Shui (Choi Yuen)) – Special departures will be added to run between Huanggang Port and Tin Fu Bus Terminus.

    4 Proposed New Franchised Bus Routes:


    • Route 1 (Huanggang Port – Kwai Chui Estate Public Transport Interchange): Daily 24-hour service.
    • Route 2 (Huanggang Port – Kai Tak (Olympic Avenue) via Central Kowloon Route): Passes through Kai Tak (including the Kai Tak Sports Park) and the Tai Lam Tunnel Interchange area. Operates daily during morning and evening peak hours.
    • Route 3 (Huanggang Port – Wu Kai Sha Station Public Transport Interchange): Passes through Ma On Shan, Science Park, Kwong Fuk Estate Interchange, Kwu Tung North New Development Area, and San Tin Public Transport Interchange. Daily 24-hour service.
    • Route 4 (Huanggang Port – Castle Peak Bay Bus Terminus): Passes through Tuen Mun Central and Hung Shui Kiu. Full-day service on Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays.

    High-Speed Rail Connections: Direct to Qianhai, Airport, and Guangzhou XintangFurthermore, the Guangzhou-Shenzhen Intercity Railway is expected to be extended to Huanggang Port between this year and next. After crossing the border, travelers can board the Hexie (Harmony) bullet trains to quickly reach Bao'an District, Qianhai, Nanshan, Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, Dongguan City Center, and Guangzhou Xintang. This will make it the second port to feature a direct high-speed rail connection.
